chapter.verse: Numei pilte in innsung nuntakna khangsak a, numei haite in innsung susia hi.
Thuman-a gamta mite in Topa zahtak a, a sia-a gamta mite in simmawh hi.
Mihaite a pau ciangin satna thuaklawh uh a, mipilte’ pauna in sat nading pan pengsak hi.
Bawngtal om kei leh lo panin an tawm bek kila a, bawngtal’ tha tawh an kihau hi.
A citak teci in thuman bekbek gen tawntung a, a gina lo teci in zuauthu bekbek gen tawntung hi.
Mi a simmawh theite in pilna a zon’zon hangin ngah zo lo a, thu ngaihsun theite in olno takin ngah thei uh hi.
Mihaite tawh kikhawl kei in, amau’ kiang pan pilna na ngah kei ding hi.
Thu ngaihsun theite a pilna in lampi man musak a, mihaite a haina in lam khialsak hi.
Mihaite in a khialh hangun phamawh sa lo uh a, mipilte a khialh ciangun mawh maisak ding deih uh hi.
Lungdamna leh lungkhamna eimah bek in i theih hi a, midang kuamah in hong phawkpih kha lo hi.
Migilote’ inn kisusia ding a, thuman mite’ inn kipin gina semsem ding hi.
Mihingte in thuman lampi hi a cih khakte pen, sihna lampi na hi kha thei hi.
Nuihna in cihmawh seelna zong hi thei a, kigualnop sakna a ven’ciangin dahna hong kilang kik hi.
Misia in siatna thaman ngah a, mipha in phatna thaman ngah hi.
Mihaite in a thu zak peuh um pahpah a, mipilte in a gamtat nading ngaihsun cian hi.
Mipilte in Topa zahtakin siatna panin kihem a, mihaite in thu ngaihsun masa loin gamta pahpah hi.
A lungtom mite hai gamtat a, ngaihsutna hoih lo a neite kimudah hi.
Mihaite in haina bek mah ngah a, mipilte in pilna mah ngah thuah hi.
Migilote in mihoihte mai-et uh a, maipha a piak nading uh thuum uh hi.
Kuamah in mizawngte ngai lo a, mihaute in lawm tampi nei hi.
Mizawngte a simmawhte a khial hi a, mizawngte’ tungah a cinghte thupha ngah ahi hi.
Na a hoih a semte, mite in muangin zahtak a, asia gamtatna in khialhna lianpi ahi hi.
Gimpi-a nasepna in hauhna hi a, kam bek pau-in tut mawkna in zawn’na ahi hi.
Pilna in mipilte’ minthan’na lukhu hi a, haina in mihaite’ kizepna bulpi pen ahi hi.
Thutak a gen teci in nuntakna hu zo a, thuzuau a gen teci in mi lehhek hi.
Topa a zahtak mi in lungmuanna nei a, a tate’ belh theih ding ahi hi.
Topa zahtakna in nuntakna tuinak tawh kibang a, sihna thang tawh kipelhsak hi.
Mi tampi a uk kumpipa a minthang a, a uk ding mi om kei leh a mawkna hi.
A lungduaite mipil hi a, lungtomna in haina kilatna hi.
Lungnopna in pumpi cidamsak a, hazatna in guh muatsak natna ahi hi.
Mizawngte bawlsiatna in a piangsak Pasian simmawhna hi a, mizawngte tungah citna in Pasian zahtakna ahi hi.
Migilopa, ama tatsiatna in puksak a, mihoihpa, ama hoihtatna in hu hi.
Thungaihsun theite’ lungsim sungah pilna teeng a, mihaite in pilna thei kha lo uh hi.
Thumanna in minam minthangsak a, mawhna in minam mindaisak hi.
A hoih-a gamta mite tungah kumpipa lungdam a, a gina-a gamta lote daan pia hi.
